submission.justification: Mixture-G3 at a 2 mm gap gave the best simulated time resolution, 0.897 ns. The other results (ns) were G3 0.999 at 1 mm and 1.003 at 3 mm, G2 1.51/1.28/1.47 at 1/2/3 mm, and G1 2.29/1.99/2.25 at 1/2/3 mm. The gap dependence is weak, with a minimum near 2 mm. WARNING: the project documents contain no environmental or safety policy, so I could not check compliance. G3 is the standard fluorinated mixture and may be restricted by such a policy, for example on global warming potential. The 90% recirculation system does not show that it complies. Someone should check the policy before this is adopted. If G3 is not allowed, the fallback is G2 at 2 mm (1.279 ns).

requirements.evidence: G3 at 2 mm gave 0.897 ns, the lowest of all 9 mixture and gap combinations simulated except none lower; G2 best 1.279 ns, G1 best 1.988 ns.
